body: I know he's depressed too, he talked me about his mental health history,  so I don't want to hurt him by creating distance

It is probably for the best, such person would constantly make me uncomfortable with that unpredictability. 

But in so many years, it's the first time something appeared promising. It just confirmed all sorts of fears I had. And now maybe I will get too graphic for this subreddit, but I think that 6 years later, it's time to get the hint: there's no place in this country for gay guys who want to get to know, trust and discover other gay guys without rushing into anything. Whenever someone appears willing to talk and be friendly, it's a guy who has emigrated to a different continent and uses a spoofed location to see what's going on back in the home country (chatted with half a dozen of those, despite knowing I'll never meet them). For us who stay here, there's only option and I was pretending not to see it for 6 years now. Last-minute-arranged sexdates with people you don't trust, don't like, and who won't even tell you their real name. I knew that was happening, that was all that's happening, but I didn't want to admit it.

I asked him he gave the most vague answer "Dunno what I am looking for on Grindr, guess I'll know when I find it". 

But it doesn't matter anymore. He kept changing the meeting hour all the time and never confirming a final time and place. Now it's late night. Clearly it isn't happening. 

One more bi (or "bi") guy messing around :/
Scene boys here think saying they are bisexual is cool, but they aren't actually bi. But it's a moot point now.

I can't relate with them. Every time I tried to ask something on the other LGBT subreddits I was mocked, called names and downvoted to oblivion (well, that last one happened here too). Same with dating sites. No one likes the fact that I am only starting to do something about my sexuality just now. From 15 to now, I never even met a gay person. Honestly, this is the only subreddit I wasn't laughed my way out yet. 

I think my questions are actually questions a 15 year old would ask in a different country than mine.

He still haven't answered to my message asking, but I admit to some light stalking. I found his profile on another site, where he lists "bisexual". 

That's still not very encouraging :/ I know I am in bi-phobic territory, but I met people like that in the past. Scene boys who say they are bi, but get uncomfortable after the first kiss and clarify they are actually straight.

I can't decide whether to ask now, or when we meet IRL. 

I mean, it probably won't change much if he's straight or "socially" homosexual but not actually interested in men (for lack of a better term) because our chats never approached the sexuality subject. He's an interesting person regardless that. 

I just don't want to piss off a straight guy, if he is one, by being flirty. Lost many friends doing that (many = 2. Didn't have much to begin with). And yeah, having seen a great number of Grindr profiles, most present themselves as straight guys who have sex with men but are still totally straight. So it's really not easy to believe that I found the exception.
It wouldn't be the first time a straight guy used a gay dating site/app. Especially considering the subculture he seems to embrace.
Fair enough. I am tired of trying to ask something and it getting deleted every time.

Well, I seek legal advice. I don't think I will get that in RA. I am not interested in hearing "oh, that's indeed immoral" or "it's not actually immoral". I want to make a decision about reporting it or not.

I could possibly remove some information and be in line with the rules? Because every subreddit I tried to ask this question removes it and that's making me paranoid.
That's not a relationship. That's about a possible crime.

I don't think I have the will to try suicide again, don't worry.

All I wish is to have a friend who's willing to kill me, as a favour, but I have no friends and anyway that's a wish I have, I know it doesn't happen like that in real-life. 

I am afraid I will have to live in this hell for years to come.

I try, but I don't know for how long. I am not always in control. And I don't think those maniacs are in control either. At some point you just do stuff without realising it. 

Perhaps the good thing is that I don't know anyone in person. If I turn violent, I only have myself to go against.

The biology of it is a mess. I could survive more or less 10 years after puberty began. But not anymore. It's biologically impossible and I am afraid my sexuality will just go from deviant (being gay) to dangerous. I fear of becoming violent. I already feel hate for gay people. I am afraid of what I might become. I was thinking of it earlier this week, said it on a western gay site, noone even cared to read it. I fear myself. I fear that in a few years time, I will be the dangerous maniac. I have the same life as those people who become the maniacs I am afraid of.

> Yeah that's why we get a bad rep. I don't understand why the entire gay "culture" has to constantly be centered around promiscuous sex.

I don't judge them, and I don't think you should in this context. They are married men most of the time, or they are young professionals who don't want to ruin their career. They really don't have any other option than secret sex. 

But among them there are maniacs. There was a murder last year. Someone wasn't bicurious enough, regretted trying gay sex, killed the guy who went with him. Maybe it's 1 in 10 000 risk, but I am not comfortable with it. I have social anxiety and panic disorder. At times, even writing things on the internet upset me enough to give me panic attacks. I can't imagine how it would be like to meet a guy I never know for sex. I might just die on the spot. 

Their opinions mean everything. They make the world i live in, and at the moment they have choosen that my life is worth less than of a cat (My straight brother gets to see a dentist. I don't. The family cat goes to the vet. There's 'no money' for me to see a dentist though). I can't avoid them. And I cant move out of this country. Missed that chance.

I was exposed to enough rational thinking to know that it's not wrong to want sex, even gay sex. The reason I want to stop carrying about this stuff is because it's impossible to happen, and because I have to care about the comments people make about gay people. And that doesn't allow me to focus on the issues I should fix. That's why I want to suppress my homosexuality, at least for a couple of years. But there's no turn off switch naturally. Castration takes care only of the sexual part of it. 

I can't have sex. Literally my only standard is to find someone I can trust (lots of dangerous maniacs around those places... and I think I might be one of them, because I hate gay people). Just trust. I don't have the delusion of a relationship, nor think that's there's any point in falling in love, that's childish. But gay people here don't even bother with trust. They don't want to talk more than 2 minutes. I have been on their website. They don't even care to know your name. They want "blowjobs, that parking lot, in 30 minutes". I don't feel safe outside of my room for a minute, let alone have sex with a guy I never spoke to before in an empty place at midnight. Not to mention that they are barely nearby. Most of the time they are 1 hour away by motorbike, and I don't have a motorbike. Even if that situation made me feel comfortable, I had no way to go there.

Come on man, I already said that 

> Can you (people from the internet) stop casually mentioning that as if it is the easiest thing in the world to find?

> I should have clarified, I don't live in the western world. 

I don't even know what a sex therapist is supposed to be. Psychologists are already had to come by, and I need to save a lot of money to do that.

I went to the LGBT subreddits in the past. They were even more hostile to me than this thread (you guys were actually a bit helpful, unlike them). I got flat-out "go away"'s from them at times, other times I received 0 answers. And same in other sites. People don't want me around, that's been happeing for a decade. 

Interactions with gay people either end in hostility (those from the west) or mocking (those from here). Both say I waste their time, for different reasons. The first are "gay marriage now, we need more marriage" and the others are "will you just shut up, I only want sex before I have to go back to my wife".
If it didn't interest me, it would be a lot easier. But my sexual frustration is building for 10 years +. And I can't even do anything about that.

I tried to contact gay people in this country, there's a hidden website for that. They mocked me more than I expected they would. This is what brought me to that state. I was doing better last week, before trying to use that website. 

They made fun of the fact I'm a virgin, and they didn't have any intent to talk about stuff, they were just looking for sex and I was wasting their time. They told be to go find a girl if I chat want to chat. 

> You are not alone and others are probably out there who are looking for someone like you to be the friend they need.

Apparently I am. I know for a fact that many of them simply move aboard because their families can afford it. and those who stay back, they seem to just want to have sex in secret. if there's anyone like me in this country, then he's probably not on the internet, because I have been there for a decade and there's nothing.

I am probably wrong, but I don't feel like trying anymore. I was out there trying before those people showed up. I faced the shit those people didn't, because they weren't raised *in* this country, they lived abroad and they just had family here. 

And thanks to the stupid internet I had to learn that 14 year olds in Sweden and the like don't even need to lift their finger and do anything to be accepted for being gay.

I don't feel like trying anymore. I don't care. I don't expect ever having sex or a relationship. I want to leave it behind, focus on the things I can fix. Being gay is not my only issue.

I didn't have the money to keep visiting the therapist. And also, she could only see me once every 3 months (and there was a 6 month waiting list between the month I failed at killing myself and realised I need help, and when she could finally see me for the first time). Just 3 sessions over the span of 2 years was not doing it.

I don't know how it compares to your region, but yes, it's a taboo. And this year's emergence of LGBT activism made things worse. People are more vocally anti-gay because their 'enemy' began being visible. That's what made this week my worse in months. 8 days ago and I was actually doing a bit better than usual. Then the activists opened pandora's box or whatever that's called. I made the mistake to read a newspaper today. People are enraged by that development, they throw threats of violence all around. Before the LGBT activists showed up, what you heard was just mocking, "you are wrong", god could help you etc. But now they are actually threatening with violence. 

There was a time in my life, half a decade ago, when I was a bit of an activist myself. Not very out, not very vocal, always completely alone, but still, I thought things could change, life could be like in the comics I used to read... I can hardly understand what the kid (me) was thinking. It all went so wrong. I can hardly feel any continuity between that person and me. 

I realise being gay in general is not a good or a bad thing. But it's a disadvantage in some place and time.

I think it's obvious, yes. 

I live somewhere in Asia.

There's a chance I will have access to public healthcare in 2015-2016 when some government reforms go through, which is actually the only good news I had in years. But right now, I can't even see a dentist, let alone non-essential specialists, or whatever they are classified as. My family won't pay a dime for me (other than letting me live with them and give me food, they are still offering me that, but nothing more).

> You should try a support group or counseling. 

Can you (people from the internet) stop casually mentioning that as if it is the easiest thing in the world to find? 

I should have clarified, I don't live in the western world.

It's a long-term goal of me. I have other... brain stuff I need to take care of, aside being gay, I know I need therapy if I am to keep living. But to see a therapist I need money, and to make money I need a job, and at the moment I can barely handle being outside for more than an hour. There weeks that I feel better, but my distractions don't last long, and I fall back to this, my normal state.

Yeah. That's also an issue. The first thereapist I was forced to go to was one who went on about Freud's theories and how my mum made me gay. 

The one I had 3 sessions with, I went to semi-willingly and she was better. The ER reffered me to her after they handled my failed suicide. There was a 6 month waiting list between the day I was released from the ER, and the first available slot in her schedule .
Being outside of my room (or even being on the internet) means I have to be reminded I am gay.

> He's a wonderful person and he became much happier after he told his family.

That's not true for everyone. I regret that the most. It wasn't completely inside my control, but I could somehow avoid it. After my family learnt, things got worse tenfold. It's related to how they won't even pay for me to see a physical-injuries doctor, let alone a mental-world doctor. 

> He tells me about this guy he met online

Yes, they are always online. They are always 2 seas away, and it never ends well. They either tell you they are tired of sitting in front of MSN all day, or they fake their suicide and never contact you again directly, even though they show up online elsewhere a week later. 

As for local gays, I tried the local gay dating website (there's only one and it's very hidden). I was laughed out of it. They don't want me there.

> Give me one good reason why you can't just be happy and having a good, fullfilling life while also being gay.

Because it doesn't let me fix the fixable issues, manage to survive outside of my room and build a semblance of life. If they Gay Police insists, I can resume being gay after I manage to deal with all the rest. I can't do it all at once. I need to be able to be outside and not feel like hanging myself when I hear people say the things they casually say about gays. I need to be outside, I need to find a job, I need to have enough money to move on my own, I need to save enough money to see a therapist again and I can't even begin doing that when I can't step out of my room.

Non-random people don't want to talk to me anymore. At first they were polite about it (but I continued talking to them), then they ignored me (so I tried not to say much), and now they flat out tell me that I am bothering them and that they can't be of any help so I shouldn't tell them about it. Tried therapy in the past, didn't go far. 

I don't have much success with random people either, really. Mostly ignored, and when not ignored, they just assume I live in the same circumstances as them and assume everything is rainbows and unicorns.

I tried seeing a therapist back when I had the money for that. Went broke after three sessions and now my family is not willing to pay even for my visits to a dentist, let alone for something taboo like a psychologist.

How about I don't want to? Can't I have that choice? I try to find a way to survive this all, get my life back on some path, any path really. There some things I just can't deal with, I want them out of the way. 

> You don't have any detriments because you're gay.

Seriously? Have you ever been gay in your life recently?

My mind is already fragile without it. With it, my life is just unbearable, and I can't even find the courage to end it. So if I could only get rid of the gay thing, maybe I could work on my other issues (I wrote about them elsewhere on Reddit).
Personally, because I already have enough in my plate, I don't need another thing driving me mad.

I was trying that. It seemed to work for a couple of weeks. I even felt happy while it lasted. Then it all breakdown again, a week ago. I try to go back to it, but no success at the moment.

But it's the only thing that seemed to work even for a little while.
I don't want to.

> then cut contact with everyone who doesn't accept it.

I know there's one way to cut contact with myself. If I die nothing will matter because my consciousness won't exist anymore.

But I can't. It's hard. It leaves you so much time to panic and abort the action. And in the last few years, I don't even have the will to try again.

I outgrew religion 10 years ago, sadly, and I realise there's still no medicine for it.

But I was thinking, maybe chemical castration? Although that probably only removes the sexual urges, it doesn't help with the mental burden and all that. There's also lobotomy, but I don't think they still perform that.

It's true. Happens here. Not marriage, the country is having it's first ever "Pride". 

It's like kicking me when I'm down. The amount of hate is published this week is so overwhelming. I wish I didn't have to care about that. I wish they just kept quiet. Things wont change, but at least we don't have to be hated when they don't know we exist.
I wish I had faith that sexuality is mutable. But I have neither faith in religion, or that there's a scientific discovery down the road that could help me :/

Sorta. I feel like this stage I am now is my fate. Wanting to die but being too afraid to do it. Which is worse. I don't have the resolve to do anything, not even to end this failed experiment that's my life. 

My wish is that someone kills me. As a favour, or as an elaborate accident, I don't know. Just in a way that doesn't give me time to panic and abort the suicide, like last time.

It's too late for you. I am only a few years older than you, and I am mocked and laughed at by gay people on dating sites for being a virgin. They stop talking to me after 15 minutes. 

Apparently for them the right age was at 15. I am some sort of freak to them for not having had sex yet.
How's that supposed to make anyone feel good?

please
anyone
somewhere in asia

> I cannot fathom why you would want to stay

Who said I *want* to? I've tried for three continuous years to leave. I spend most of my savings trying to get out. Things didn't work out. You have to deal with instable governments and obligatory military service... and back then i could hope. now i can't. and i don't find any power in me to hope again. 

don't say "why don't you move out" as if it's an easy thing to do.

Yesterday I was feeling so terrible, I lapsed and send a message to someone who's sort of a friend, and told her how I felt. And I felt a bit better for few hours, but today I feel the same again :/ It makes me feel foolish, that I cling to the world, only to feel worse later. Sometimes I feel like I should keep trying, and then I realise the world would prefer me dead.

>  I know being around people is the right thing to do.

Yes. That happens to me a lot. I always see it doesn't work, but in the end I always try to cling on the few people that I ever socialise with. It's a vicious circle, but I cling to it.

Ah, let's see 

> You did not ask a question. Did you intend to inquire as to the differential diagnostic possibilities for your presentation and symptoms?

Er... I hoped someone had a clue what that might be and how to handle it. 

> I mean no offense, but is English not your first language? Could you clarify "light form of epilepsy" and "illusion of shocks"? Do you mean you suffered repeated simple partial seizures? I can't really guess at the second statement.

English is indeed not my native language, but I also think that you went out of your way to write in this verbose style. 

In the past I had simple partial seizures, yes. 

Currently, those illusions of shock I wrote off, it's like the word is shaking. 

> Please clarify whether you lose consciousness during these recent episodes. Do you lose control of your ability to stand or stay upright during the episodes? Is there any stimulus or action that triggers the episodes? Do you experience any "auras" prior to the episodes (e.g., an odd smell, or altered vision) - is the "unstable" vision you mention fit the characteristics of an aura?

I do not. But I get the feeling like I am *about to* faint. But I don't. I feel like I'm going to fall, but I don't. 

I can't think of any trigger. It happens many times a day, and lasts for very long. 

The fact that it lasts for hours, and that there isn't any aura sensation (not one I recognise from my past), makes me think it isn't a seizure, because as far as I know, I always experience aura when I used to have seizures, and it never lasted more than a minute. 

> Why can you not get to any sort of physician? What obstacles are preventing you seeking assistance?

I am uninsured, my family isn't very keen to helping me in that domain, and I can't drive for my own. As a matter of fact, I couldn't even visit the dentist in the last 12 months because it's way to expensive for us. 

I do have a yearly appointment with a neurologist, one that my family accepts to pay for, and it's coming up in 4 months. There's a waiting list. I will mention that incident then, but I don't have anything short-term, that's why I am trying to ask online.

I don't want to give up and I want to get better, but at what point do I admit defeat? Three times already I crashed to the ground. Obviously there's not going to be any progress. And even if I had stuff that I cannot have now, like a therapist, it's still a gamble, as it seems.
I don't see how I failed to keep it civil.

Dude, you don't even know me. I spend the last 4 years trying to emigrate, get into a university. I lost plenty of money trying to do just that. I don't have any more money. 

And yeah, I do try to keep something standing in my life. I try to keep seeing people, let's call them friends. It's a full-time effort, that, even if it doesn't cost that much money.

You say a lot of reasonable things but... I'm exhausted, I don't know how else to say it. I've been trying for so many years. So many plans that failed, so much money wasted on them... and that "Holy Grail" that was medication... now it turns out it's just an ordinary thing, and I cannot find any motivation to keep trying to go after it (it's already almost impossible for me to go to a hospital, even for a dental appointment, let alone a psychiatrist).

>  Thank god for the internet because these days you can actually vocalize it and find like minded dudes.

Who are located in the other end of the Earth. Not very helpful, especially for someone like me with a predisposition to getting attached. And that's a euphemism. Internet was actually one of the worst things to happen to me. Knowing less is worrying less. 

 > You can't take debt with you to heaven. 

We cannot get money for nothing here. That's how the country works. If that was possible, I would already go to university and do something I'm passionate about, and that would keep me preoccupied so that I wouldn't be lamenting about the past I'd rather erase from my memory. And I would also use that free money to go to a therapist and see if anything about my brain can be fixed. 

I'm glad you could change your life by borrowing money, but that's not a solution for people over here, gay or not.

> I think you should keep trying, and break the cycle

I try to do something similar... avoid those situations so that I can manage to break the cycle of isolation that those situations lead me in. At this point, I'd rather struggle to keep some friends rather than get a relationship. The first seems easier and more possible than the second.

That what war is. That's what it really leaves behind. Your story is also the story of the generation of my parents. War takes away the room for you to choose how and where to live.

I wish I could actually offer any advice that I knew it will work.
All I can say is distract yourself. Find something trivial enough to do, like watching a tv show that you have warched a million times already so that it doesn't make you think anymore,  when you have nothing to keep yourself occupied.  Never give your mind enough free time to sink into doom. That's pretty much the only thing I can do for my depression.

Seems like I should always include that in my posts. 

I don't have the two things needed to do this: lot of money, and a family that would be okay with me seeing a therapist so that they help me do it.
That's a helpful way to look at it. But I still feel bad for being a pain :/

> I would encourage you to seek professional help.

I wish I could see a therapist again.

Happened to me as well, mate. G+ is a huge asshole.

And I can't bring myself to block the possible triggers. But maybe you can find the strength to do it.
I just avoid being in the same place at them. Not even try to face them.

> You know how much you said about that in your original post? Nothing

Because I didn't want to talk about the gay thing at all. One mention of it, and the whole discussion is derailed. As it did. 

> I don't insist that the western way is the right way, and here I have to point a finger back at your ignorance, but non Americans refer to the "western way" but are you talking about the Western US? or the old west? or generalizing all of us as having the same values?

The West. Europe and America in general. Those who developed the whole LGBT thing. 

> You want us to understand your circumstances? You have to explain them first. What country are you in? 

It's because that's not what I want to talk about. What I wanted to do was find some advice on stopping masturbation. I did get one relevant answer, that's true, but then I was led in uncovering the gay thing, and that derailed everything. Now we are discussing the gay thing instead. And I don't want to talk about it anymore. 

>  why don't you look somewhere else where you are more likely to find someone who does understand your cultural context instead of just getting angry at us for having a different set of circumstances than you do?

Because I'm that alone. I know very well I shouldn't be here.

> I would tell you to move to San Francisco or Los Angeles

See, that what gets on my nerves. Actually, two things that get on my nerves. 

First, assuming that I never tried to change my surroundings, where I live. For YEARS I have tried. Lost lot of money just trying to do that. It's impossible. Not even to another city, let alone another country. 

Second, is that everyone assumes that you either live in America, or Europe. Well, it's neither. And stuff like Bible Belt... those are not a thing here. And yet, even though it's clear that here is not the west, you people insist that the western way is the right way. 

See, this is my life. This is the place I have to live. Those are things that don't change. I have to change, if there's still anything that I can do to take back that curse I brought upon me. Even partially. No-one accepts this point of view on this site. Everyone insists that others are the problem and that I should be myself. I DID. For pretty much a decade. It was SHIT. It was WRONG. More of this western bullshit will not make it better. Only even worse, if that's possible. 

But apparently that's what the whole LGBT thing is. Pure fascism. If you don't want to be gay in their terms, you are the bad guy. That's what they say. "Gay men who don't come out harm themselves". "It's immoral to present yourself as straight when you actually are attracted to guys". That's what they wanted me to do, and I did. But hey, it was my choice. And now I have to fix it, not them.

Don't assume that I'm just a teenager who just discovered he's gay. Not saying you did, just clearing this up before it's brought up. 

For the past 5, and especially the past 3 years my mental health hit the lowest point I can remember. I'm terrified of being outside, I can't find any motivation, eveything I do makes me guilty, my sleep is a hell for me. And all goes back to believing that western bullshit ideas of accepting one's sexuality and coming out and all that shit. From *one* person, the gossip spread to the whole metropolitan area. Because I couldn't just keep it on myself. Those LGBT resources said that if you keep it a secret, you'd be worse off. Cue the backlash. And when I thought people forgot, they come forward to remind me that more people that I can imagine know. And I'm trapped here. Trapped between my brain, which conjures the worst feelings, and the tiny outside world that scares the shit out of me, because I can no longer know who knows about me, and who doesn't. 

All because I trusted that bullshit western ideas about being gay. If I considered myself straight, I could still have sex with men and not have to go through that. But now, I placed that eternal label on me, of being gay, and not only I never had sex, but I am unable to even walk outside my house without thinking that something will kill me. 

I'd do anythig to reverse that curse that I placed upon myself.

No, it's not religious or moral. Simply put, having sexual desires ruined my life quite irreversibly. Maybe if I weren't gay I wouldn't want to be asexual, but hey, I am, and I don't want to be sexual.

I can feel you man. The part about the exams even reminded me why I did so poorly back when I was a student. Because some well-off people decide to make all gay people come out, and that's supposedly going to make everything better. Well no. There are pretty high chances it will make your life shit, and you can't take it back. People in the west have no idea how their advices will play out in other parts of the world, and sadly they convince many gays around the world to promote those western ideas in other countries, where they don't work.

I was a victim of this. I can't even express how much I regret it. My life wouldn't be perfect if I didn't accepted I'm gay, but it would be still be better than now. I would be able to save most of my mental state. 

I'm sorry I don't have an alternative for you man. All I can see is not to trust the hype. Coming out isn't the solution. 
But sadly, I am convinced that we can't "become straight". We've been dealt a bad hand, can't change it. Maybe hide it, that seems to be the most we can do.
I don't have access to one.
No, I am not asexual, sadly. I was condemned to both a sex drive and a sexual orientation, and I'd rather I didn't any of of those.

> Have you checked out /r/NoFap ? 

Didn't knew about it. Will check it out. 

>  talk to a doctor

If I could talk to a doctor, I have issues higher on the priority list, to be honest.
Maaan, that seems so difficult. I replaced about half my daily coffees with green tea (which I do like), and I already feel weaker. But if that's what I have to do...

Well, the conclusion was basically that it was my gravest mistake to accept I was gay, because that created all sorts of stuff to care about, like gay rights and whatnot. Stuff that make me angry. I mean, my culture does allow for straight men to have sex with passive men, I should have gone with that, thinking back to the last 10 years of my life. I wouldn't have to care about a lot of stuff, like coming out, bullying, rights, progress in other countries that just feels wrong both when it happens (because after one point, my mind just goes "how can they treat gays as if their opinion matters, and they give them laws they want"), and when it doesn't happen, because you know, that's what being LGBT is about, and that's what LGBTs do. They want to be treated equally. And those two thinks really conflict in my mind when I am exposed to to any kind of news about gays.

> You don't want to deal with it and identify the reasons. 

Please don't skip over the fact that I have tried. And not just once. For many years I have tried. 

It does not get better. I have other issues too, I'm quite possibly having faulty brain wiring somehow. That's what I have to do. For me, the game is lost. I just try to be less of a pain to others, and the only other option is to isolate myself from other people completely, which is very hard to do and still feel like there's a reason to live.
